business_problem: BBVA needed to reduce the time employees spent searching dispersed legal and operational documentation, speed up marketing content creation, help staff find relevant data in its enterprise data model, and improve software development productivity across the group.
solution_summary: BBVA deployed ChatGPT Enterprise at group scale and used it to build customized GPTs for specific internal workflows. In the legal function, BBVA loaded consultation documents, product specification sheets, and internal and external regulations into a GPT so lawyers could retrieve relevant guidance faster and draft fuller answers before a human review step. In marketing, BBVA configured another GPT with instructions, contextual documents, and examples of prior high-performing campaign text so it could generate search-optimized ad copy. For data governance, BBVA connected a GPT-driven conversational interface to its Single Data Model so employees could find data types, identify data owners, and see where data had already been used in other applications. BBVA also created an internal GPT Store to publish reusable assistants, while developers used ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot for coding, documentation, and code translation tasks.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides the group-wide generative AI environment used by employees to run and scale BBVA's internal use cases.

solution_components.name: GPT
solution_components.role: Customized assistants package documents, instructions, and context for legal support, marketing copy generation, and data discovery workflows.

solution_components.name: Single Data Model
solution_components.role: Centralizes departmental and operational information that employees query through a conversational GPT experience to find data and ownership.

solution_components.name: GPT Store
solution_components.role: Acts as BBVA's internal library for locating and reusing GPTs that can be shared across the organization.

solution_components.name: GitHub Copilot
solution_components.role: Supports developers with code improvement, new feature development, documentation generation, and code translation.

data_flow: BBVA feeds legal reference material, regulations, campaign instructions, contextual documents, and prior campaign text into task-specific GPTs running in ChatGPT Enterprise. For data discovery, the GPT interface helps employees navigate metadata and usage information in the Single Data Model. Outputs are then consumed by lawyers, marketers, data users, and developers, with reusable assistants distributed through BBVA's internal GPT Store.
business_outcome: BBVA reports faster legal response preparation, higher-quality first responses, shorter marketing content creation cycles, improved ad visibility and clicks, faster data discovery, and better developer productivity through task-specific generative AI assistants.
